name: PS5 FSR4 Showcase
description: Shows AMD FSR 4 upscaling on the PS5: a city at dusk rendered small and upscaled at 60 fps, with settings to compare it against bilinear and native rendering.
author: BlackBearReloaded
release_notes:
Experimental pre-release of the PS5 FSR4 port, built by GitHub Actions from 7fe9ec2273629e8ac1938a58249b1983a19fff3f (Vulkan driver 4bb0c8b1423698a7369efc22b829bf16a99e7128).
- Asset · Contents
- ps5-fsr4-showcase-01.000.010-PPSA99011.zip · The PS5 FSR4 Showcase app, ready to install (see its README)
- ps5-fsr4-sdk-01.000.010.zip · The ps5_fsr4 SDK for native PS5 applications
- ps5-fsr4-01.000.010-source.tar.gz · Corresponding source: this repository with its Vulkan driver, ps5-agc-gears and the native app template
- SHA256SUMS · SHA-256 of the assets

Install the showcase: extract the showcase zip, upload its PPSA99011 folder to /data/homebrew/ on a PS5 running a homebrew loader with ShadowMountPlus, and start PS5 FSR4 Showcase from the home screen once it is registered. It opens with a guided tour and OPTIONS opens its settings; controls and performance.

Use the SDK: see FSR4_SDK.md in the SDK zip.

AMD / GPUOpen created FSR4. The INT8 optimizations come from the BC250 FSR4 project (dmoraza and daniel-h-0 with contributors). This build is modified, unofficial and not affiliated with or endorsed by AMD or Sony Interactive Entertainment. Each zip's notices/ holds AMD's license and the provenance of the FSR4 material.
